strategy_performance.number_level_null: per-target conditional hypergeometric null preserving five distinct winning numbers among 40 ranked positions; normal approximation for the sum
strategy_performance.all5_null: exact binomial tail with per-target hypergeometric probability C(K,5)/C(40,5)

pairwise_relationships.method: Holm-Bonferroni over exact paired sign tests

conditional_state_policy: State metrics are computed from prior outcomes only; conditional candidates are descriptive and are not promoted.
retrospective_policy: Q80 best-per-target is catalogued separately and excluded from ex-ante target rows.
